description_en: Creates an internal-facing access tag under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 创建当前阿里云账号下内网访问标签
name: CreatePrivateAccessTag

parameters.help_en: The name of the internal-facing access tag. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Chinese characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问标签名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: 这是一条内网访问标签
parameters.help_en: The description of the internal-facing access tag. The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), and spaces. Chinese characters are supported
parameters.help_zh: 内网访问标签描述。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和空格
parameters.name: description

TagId.description_en: The ID of the internal-facing access tag
